name: ciel-mirages-grave-omen-counter-deals-two-unpreventable-damage-to-a-unit
notes: Armoire banishes a hand card with an omen counter; Ciel, Mirage's Grave's trigger offers up to one target.

rulesClauses: Whenever an omen counter is put on a card in your banishment, as a Spell, deal 2 unpreventable damage to up to one target unit.
